TXJ1.note: TXJ1 junction (16 PTH pads on TX_A and TX_B): the two TX coil leads, 3.0 mm tracks, HV 1.0 mm between the nets. Connectivity drawing, no discrete parts.

SB1R-QA.note: SB1R-QA receive coil board: net QA_COIL (leads P1, P2, RD1 across them), transfer pads T1 / T2 on net QB_T1 / QB_T2 with RD2 across them, and three M3 holes. Connectivity drawing.

SB1R-QB.note: SB1R-QB receive coil board: net QB_COIL on the two lead pads P1, P2 and three M3 holes. No discrete parts. Connectivity drawing.
